messages:
anya: FYI support case: user hit a 500 while onboarding, turned out to be invalid key but body was `{'error':'internal_error'}`. Very confusing.
kevin: Oof. We should return a consistent envelope so SDKs can map to typed exceptions.
anya: Minimal envelope idea: {error:{code,status,message,hint,request_id}}. Hints should be actionable for onboarding.
sam: Agreed. Map code namespaces to SDK classes: authentication.*, rate_limit.*, validation.*. Add retryable flag and retry_after where appropriate.
kevin: SDKs: RedwoodError base + subclasses (AuthenticationError, RateLimitError, ValidationError, TransientServiceError). Each carries code,status,requestId,hint,raw.
docs-bot: Note: update onboarding sample to show catching AuthenticationError and showing hint + link to key rotation.
anya: Rollout plan: opt-in header X-Redwood-Structured-Errors:1 for 2 weeks, then flip. Keep backward compatibility for a month.
kevin: I'll prototype JS/py snippets and update SDK mapping in PR.
sam: I'll stop swallowing auth in backend paths and start returning 401 + structured code. Opening ticket #1301.
anya: Action items: sam backend ticket, kevin SDK PR + samples, docs-bot update. Small telemetry: emit error.code counts.
kevin: 👍 will ping SDK owners.
